keyEvents.text: Goal! Augsburg 1, Mainz 0. Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal following a corner.
Goal! Augsburg 2, Mainz 0. Juma Bah (Augsburg) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner following a corner.
Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is shown the yellow card.
Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Mainz. Ransford Königsdörffer replaces Paul Nebel.
Goal! Augsburg 3, Mainz 0. Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal following a set piece situation.
Goal! Augsburg 3, Mainz 1. Ransford Königsdörffer (Mainz) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Danny da Costa.
Substitution, Augsburg. Arijon Ibrahimovic replaces Alexis Claude-Maurice.
Substitution, Mainz. Silvan Widmer replaces Anthony Caci.
Substitution, Mainz. Benedict Hollerbach replaces Sheraldo Becker.
Substitution, Augsburg. Seol Young-Woo replaces Marius Wolf.
Substitution, Augsburg. Uchenna Ogundu replaces Michael Gregoritsch.
Stefan Posch (Mainz) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Silvan Widmer (Mainz) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Mainz. Eric Martel replaces Danny da Costa.
Substitution, Mainz. Rael Nakuzola replaces Phillipp Mwene.
Substitution, Augsburg. Mert Kömür replaces Anton Kade.
